ai_summary: Aurum PropTech Limited reported a strong Q2 FY27, with total income up 57% year-over-year to ₹137 crore and significant profitability improvements, including a shift to a positive PBT margin of 4.8% (up 1,270 bps) and an 840 bps widening of Adjusted EBITDA margins. This marks the company's fourth consecutive quarter of positive PBT, driven by the strategic integration of Housing.com and the development of an AI-native real estate operating system aimed at enhancing monetization and operational efficiencies. No red flags are apparent in the provided financial highlights or commentary.
